criterion: Does the reply RESOLVE the customer's reported problem? Binary, as defined in week6/judge_v1.txt.
protocol: Labels were written from the ticket question and the reply body only.
The greeting, ticket-ID line, refund sentence and [ESCALATED] tag were stripped before reading: those are assertion territory and the criterion excludes them.

No judge had been run when these labels were written. week6/judge_run_*.json did not exist in the working tree or in any commit at the time this file was committed; the commit that adds this file is the proof, and it precedes the commit that adds any judge output.
The judge's offline rule executor had been written (commit 62b06f5) but never executed, so no machine verdict was visible while labelling.
Labels were not revised after the judge ran. Any later change to this file would show in git history.
